errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are not ordered alphabetically. They are ordered by the increasing value of the percentage ranges they represent (НЯМА, ДО 10%, НАД 10 ДО 25%, etc.).
The description states that the vertical axis is labeled with numbers. However, the vertical axis itself has no numerical labels or tick marks; the numbers are data labels on top of the bars.

This part of the sentence describes the vertical axis, and it incorrectly states that its highest value is 47.1%. This value is the peak data point shown on a bar, not the maximum value of the axis scale.
